# Third-party license notices

## av/remotion-bits

Pinned revision: `6c71169aa061f15313fadbdc6e29a3a3a87f2c03`

The pinned repository's `package.json` declares `"license": "MIT"`, and its
README License section says `MIT`. GitHub's license endpoint returns 404 for
this revision because the repository tree does not contain a standalone
license file. That gap is recorded rather than silently inventing an upstream
copyright line. The source URLs and both upstream-byte and local-snapshot
checksums are preserved in `manifest.json`.
